items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: So, I got to talking with Owens, my classmate, who was a trumpet player

ctx.x: So, I got to talking with Owens, my classmate, who was a trumpet player, and I said, I sure wish I could be in that band. He called and asked a few questions about music and he said you know a little bit and I said, I had one or two lessons on the piano, but I was too lazy to practice and this and that, but I want a horn. So he finally said what kind of

horn and I told him just like I said to Captain Dryer. I said any instrument, but I want to get in that band. He said I'll look around. So one day he came to me and said, Ernie, Ernie, I said what, there's this band--there's this trombone that he wants to sell and I said I don't have--and he said he'll sell it cheap, he just wants some money, he's broke and he wants some money. So he took me to this guy and this guy said yeah, I'll sell you the trombone. I said what do you want for it; he said six dollars. I said…
